instruction: On slide 2, create a title reading "Web Store" with the same red color as slide 1's title.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Shorter title text variation, maintaining the red color matching requirement from the original task. Red color RGB(255,0,0) verified from slide 1.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct title text, 0.5 for correct color, 1.0 for both correct

llm_judge_reasons: Critical: Getter uses 'first non-empty text shape' logic instead of proper title placeholder detection. If slide has other text shapes (subtitle, text boxes) before the title, getter will read wrong text.
Medium: Color extraction only checks first run of first paragraph. If title has mixed formatting or multiple runs with different colors, may not detect color correctly.
Medium: Color handling may not robustly handle theme colors vs RGB colors. If slide uses theme-based colors that render as red, comparison with RGB(255,0,0) might fail.
Positive: Postconfig correctly saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes before getter reads PPTX.
Positive: Metric logic correctly implements partial credit (0.5 for text OR color, 1.0 for both).
Positive: Complete coverage - evaluator checks both text AND color requirements.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Improve title detection: Check for title placeholder specifically using shape.placeholder_format.type == MSO_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE or shape.has_title, instead of iterating through all shapes.
Enhance color extraction: Handle case where title text has multiple runs with different colors. Consider checking all runs or the dominant color.
Add robust color handling: Handle theme colors by converting them to RGB equivalents, or add fallback logic for when run.font.color.rgb is not accessible.
Add validation: Check if the found shape is actually a title placeholder before extracting text and color.
